mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item_ship (order_id, express_company, tracking_no, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{expressCompany}, #{trackingNo}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE express_company = #{expressCompany}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT order_id as orderId, express_company as expressCompany, tracking_no as trackingNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM order_item_ship WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
